newsitem.title: USA: Collagen names Gary Petersmeyer as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Collagen names Gary Petersmeyer as CEO.

text.p: Collagen Corp Monday said its president, Gary Petersmeyer, has been appointed chief executive officer, succeeding Howard Palefsky, who will remain as chairman of the board.
The company also said David Foster was promoted to senior vice president of Collagen Corp and general manager of Collagen Technologies Group.
In addition, Collagen Corp said it named Norman Halleen a vice president, finance and chief financial officer and Jean-Pierre CapDevielle, as vice president and managing director, international.
Halleen formerly was CFO of Dutra Group.
CapDevielle had worked at Sofamor Danek Group Inc as an executive vice president, Europe.
Collagen develops, manufactures and markets biomedical devices for the treatment of defective, diseased, traumatized or aging human tissues.
